Plants of the World Online account: Palicourea padifolia (Willd. ex Schult.) C.M.Taylor & Lorence.

The native range of this species is Mexico to NW. Colombia. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome. It is used as a medicine.
